label: Proper-to-practice God-name reference…: On the same Being carrier, ProperReferencePreserved says…
definition: On the same Being carrier, ProperReferencePreserved says every instance of a selected proper God predicate is referred to by the selected name in the selected NamingPractice. SharedReferenceExtension also requires the reverse direction. ProperReferenceLost witnesses a proper instance that practice reference loses. No semantic identity, existence or correct confession follows by definition.
note: Analyst framework comparison with attribution deferred. Ordinary analogy: a designation properly fits a person whom a community does not name; conversely a practice can use a name incorrectly. These analogies do not establish actual God-name reference. DISAMB-NAME-APPLICATION keeps proper application and practice use separate. The three nominal descriptor witness propositions reuse precisely the original naming antecedents; their applicability stays open. No new source claim is attributed.
